title: fix(components): re-measure the record header's width fold on another record
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XTRdLmK9YYgMSCJ7NH2PuUY)_
Fixes #35997

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在记录页或抽屉里用上一条/下一条切换记录时,顶栏操作按钮会按新记录重新排布:从操作多的记录切到操作少的记录后,放得下的操作重新直接显示(最多三个),不再被多余地收进「更多」菜单。
- 属于记录页顶栏「最多显示三个操作、其余收进更多」那项改进的收尾,替经常翻记录的业务用户解决按钮莫名变少的问题。
- 出错时最坏是顶栏某个操作仍被收进「更多」菜单里(点开仍可用),不影响数据;只是界面渲染变化,可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- `PageHeaderActions` (record header bar, `fitWidth`): the width cap the row's wrapping lowers is now stored with the key it was measured on, the record id from the record context plus the names of the page's own inline-eligible actions. A render whose key differs (another record, or a changed action set) draws the full budget (3, or the page's `maxVisible`), and the existing layout effect measures again, so a row that still wraps folds again one action at a time. The host-resize path (`ResizeObserver` clearing the cap) is unchanged.
- The key is a string, so an equal record and action set never re-arms the fold and nothing loops: the cap is only set while the row wraps and the drawn budget is above the floor, as before.
- The cap rule and the fold rule themselves (at most 3 inline, the primary never folds, host Edit never folds) are untouched.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` — the hunk at "A cap holds only for the record and action set it was measured on" (the key and the keyed read of the cap).
2. same file — the layout effect writing `setWidthCap({ key, cap: inline - 1 })`.
3. `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-record-bar-35593.test.tsx` — the new top-level describe "re-measures the width fold on another record (objectstack#35997)".

Two-minute verification: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-record-bar-35593.test.tsx` from the repo root; expect 17 passed, among them "a record with fewer actions that fit draws min(maxVisible, count) again" and its CONTROL.

## Tests

- New pins in the existing shared harness for this row's width fold, as a new top-level describe (the harness file already pins the fold for the header bar, so the pins join it rather than a new file):
  - record A (four actions, the row wraps) folds to the primary; the host steps to record B (two actions, the row fits) by re-rendering the same tree with another record id and data: B draws both of its actions inline, i.e. min(maxVisible, count) = 2, with Edit kept.
  - CONTROL: the same switch where B's row still wraps folds B again to the primary (the fold still works after the reset).
- Ablation (one-off, not kept): the keyed read reverted to an unkeyed one (`widthCap ? widthCap.cap : null`) through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the first pin goes red with `expected [ 'Convert', 'Edit', 'More actions' ] to include 'Log call'`, 1 failed / 16 passed; restore verified by the tool (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The test imports the renderer from source, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- Zone measurement: the record page and the drawers do not remount the view between records (the view's own comment on its feed key says no mount site passes a `key=`; the drawers swap `recordIdOverride`), so the row instance and its cap do survive a record switch; the defect reproduced in the new pin before the fix (the ablation leg is that reproduction).
- The reset key carries the record id as well as the action names, as the card asks (record id or action list change). A switch between two records with the same action set therefore also re-measures once; that costs one extra synchronous layout pass and lands on the same fold.

## Verification

Every reading below is at head `621ca521`, taken under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (shared box).
